name: @lanka-playgrounds/_server
description: The API the playground applications talk to: REST, SSE, WebSocket, GraphQL and gRPC-Web, on node builtins alone.

scripts.//start: The server, for a browser to talk to. Through tsx rather than bare node: node's own TypeScript support resolves ESM the way the runtime does, so it needs a file extension on every relative import — and every other package here is written for a bundler's resolution, where they are omitted. One runner, one spelling.
